item.title: Akita Nairiku Line: A Scenic Ride Through Rural Akita — Guide
item.description: The Akita Nairiku Line is a scenic inland railway winding 94 km between Kakunodate and Takanosu, through rice valleys, mountains and the traditional Matagi hunting country of northern Akita. Passing rustic stations and river viaducts, it’s especially magical in October’s autumn colours and again under deep winter snow. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Kitaakita–Senboku, Akita Hours Regular daily services Admission ~¥1,700 (full line) Time needed About 2.
